summary: Round r1 (restricted network): primary sources located for assignment of functions and revenues across Nepal's three tiers (Constitution Schedules 5-9, Intergovernmental Fiscal Arrangement Act 2017, NNRFC Act 2017, Local Government Operation Act 2017, UNDP and Asia Foundation functional-assignment analyses), for transfer volumes and formulae (budget speeches FY2081/82 and FY2082/83, FCGO consolidated financial statements for outturn, NNRFC annual reports and recommendations) and for local capacity gaps (Federalism Capacity Needs Assessment 2019, World Bank Fiscal Federalism Updates, MoFAGA LISA framework and PLGSP progress reports). Nothing could be downloaded and snippet figures were not used, so all quantities are pending. Structural points to verify from texts: transfers comprise four grant types plus revenue sharing, NNRFC recommends equalisation formulae and revenue-sharing, and the unbundling of concurrent functions remains incomplete according to several leads.

findings.claim: Expenditure and revenue assignment across federal, provincial and local tiers
findings.note: Constitution Schedules 5-9 (exclusive and concurrent powers), IGFA Act 2017 (tax and non-tax revenue assignment and sharing), Local Government Operation Act 2017; detailed unbundling per UNDP/TAF functional-assignment reports. Leads retrieved text required for article-level citation.

findings.claim: Intergovernmental transfers by grant type (equalisation, conditional, complementary, special) and revenue sharing, budgeted vs actual
findings.note: Budget speeches FY2078/79-FY2082/83 (budget) and FCGO Consolidated Financial Statements FY2018/19-FY2023/24 (outturn), by tier and grant type. Budget vs outturn must not be mixed.

findings.claim: NNRFC equalisation-grant formula components and weights, and revenue-sharing ratios
findings.note: NNRFC annual reports and recommendations: indicator list and weights (e.g. expenditure need, revenue capacity, HDI, infrastructure, socio-economic indicators as stated in the reports), minimum/formula/performance split, VAT and excise sharing ratios, royalty distribution.

findings.claim: Share of NNRFC recommendations implemented by the federal budget
findings.note: NNRFC annual reports' implementation-status tables, compared with budget allocations.

findings.claim: Documented local-level capacity gaps (staffing, PFM, planning, procurement, service delivery)
findings.note: FCNA 2019 sample findings; World Bank Fiscal Federalism Updates 2023/2024; LISA scores by domain from MoFAGA; OAG local-level irregularities (cross-reference 11B).

findings.claim: Subnational budget execution rates (capital spending) by tier
findings.note: FCGO CFS and World Bank Fiscal Federalism Update: budget vs actual by tier.

data_gaps: Budgeted transfers by grant type and tier FY2078/79-FY2082/83 (MoF budget speeches, Red Book) - download blocked.
Actual transfers and subnational revenue/expenditure FY2018/19-FY2023/24 (FCGO CFS) - download blocked.
NNRFC formula weights and revenue-sharing ratios for each year (Nepali annual reports) - download blocked; English versions not confirmed.
LISA scores by local government and domain (MoFAGA portal) - not located as downloadable dataset.
Full text of the World Bank 2024 Fiscal Federalism Update - not yet located.
Status of the revised unbundling (functional-assignment) report by OPMCM - primary document not located.

assumptions.text: Budgeted transfers (budget speech) and actual transfers (FCGO CFS) are recorded as separate series and never mixed; all are Nepali fiscal years (mid-July to mid-July).
Revenue sharing (VAT, internal excise, royalties) is treated distinctly from grants when summing intergovernmental flows.
assumptions.basis_note: original label: 'assumption (IGFA Act structure; to be confirmed on retrieval)'

challenges.text: Share one article-level constitutional mapping for Schedules 5-9 so the assignment matrix and constitutional constraints are consistent.
Strategies assigning delivery to provinces or local levels must check assignment_matrix and capacity_gaps (pending) before assuming implementation capacity.

uncertainty: High: no values retrieved in r1. Key uncertainties: (i) budget vs outturn gaps in transfers; (ii) formula weights change year to year through NNRFC recommendations, so any single-year formula is not representative; (iii) capacity assessments (FCNA sample, LISA self-assessment) differ in method, sample and period and are not directly comparable; LISA is self-reported; (iv) the functional unbundling is not finalised, so overlaps in concurrent powers remain a qualitative constraint.

assignment_matrix.method: Matrix of functions (rows) by tier (federal/province/local, exclusive vs concurrent) from Constitution Schedules 5-9, plus revenue assignment from IGFA Act 2017 and LGOA 2017; annotate overlaps from UNDP/TAF functional-assignment analyses.

transfer_flows.method: Budgeted (budget speech) and actual (FCGO CFS) transfers by grant type and tier, NPR_current_bn, Nepali fiscal years; NNRFC formula components and weights by year; revenue-sharing flows separately.

capacity_gaps.method: Qualitative and quantitative gap inventory by domain (staffing, PFM, planning, procurement, IT, service delivery) from FCNA 2019 and World Bank Fiscal Federalism Updates; LISA domain scores; cross-reference OAG local irregularities (11B).
